name: Provincial minimum wage (baht a day)

rules.authority: Wage Committee Notification on Minimum Wage Rates (No. 14), Royal Gazette vol.142 special part 236 Ngor pp.29-31, 1 July 2025 (https://ratchakitcha.soc.go.th/documents/76681.pdf), in force 1 July 2025 (repeals No. 13 of 23 December 2024 and the hotel notification of 27 March 2024). cl.2-18 by province; Chiang Mai, Songkhla and Surat Thani are split by district (CHIANG_MAI_MUEANG, SONGKHLA_HAT_YAI, SURAT_THANI_KO_SAMUI); a day is the normal working time of at most 7 hours for hazardous work and 8 otherwise; cl.20 forbids paying less. Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) ss.79(3), 88, 90. The tiers are those of Notification No. 13 (https://www.mol.go.th/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2024/12/%E0%B8%9B%E0%B8%A3%E0%B8%B0%E0%B8%81%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%A8%E0%B8%84%E0%B9%88%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%88%E0%B9%89%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%87%E0%B8%82%E0%B8%B1%E0%B9%89%E0%B8%99%E0%B8%95%E0%B9%88%E0%B8%B3-%E0%B8%8913%E0%B8%A3%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%8A%E0%B8%81%E0%B8%B4%E0%B8%88%E0%B8%88%E0%B8%B2.pdf) with Bangkok raised from 372 to 400 and 400 extended nationwide to category 2-4 hotels and service establishments (business_400).

name: Social Security contribution return and payment (Sor Por Sor 1-10)

rules.description: File the monthly contribution return (Sor Por Sor 1-10) and pay the employee contributions deducted with the employer's own 5% to the Social Security Office.
rules.authority: Social Security Act B.E. 2533 s.47 para 2: both shares "within the fifteenth day of the month following the month in which the deduction is made"; s.49: a 2% a month surcharge on late payment. https://www.sso.go.th/wpr/download/download_by_pool_file/47435

name: PND1 monthly withholding return

rules.description: File form PND1 for the salary withholding of the month and pay the tax withheld. A return filed and paid through the Revenue Department e-filing system has 8 more days under the Ministry of Finance notification extending e-filing deadlines; the statutory 7th is the due date here.
rules.authority: Revenue Code ss.52 and 59 (within seven days of the payment) as extended by the Ministry of Finance notification of 24 July 2001: the tax withheld under s.50(1) is remitted and the PND1 return filed within seven days from the end of the month of payment. https://www.rd.go.th/2625.html An employer filing online (entity fact files_online) has until the 15th: Ministry of Finance notification on the e-filing extension (No. 7, as amended by No. 8) cl.1.3, for returns due 1 February 2024 to 31 January 2027 https://www.rd.go.th/fileadmin/user_upload/kormor/newlaw/mofexpandfornet7A.pdf.

name: PND1 Kor annual withholding return

rules.description: File form PND1 Kor listing each employee's employment income and tax withheld for the previous calendar year.
rules.authority: Revenue Code s.58(2) (within January) as extended by the Ministry of Finance notification of 2 November 1983 under s.3 octo para 2, cl.1(2): the return of income under s.40(1) and (2) is filed within February each year. https://www.rd.go.th/2619.html Filed online (entity fact files_online), PND1 Kor is due by 8 March: Ministry of Finance notification No. 9 cl.1 (Royal Gazette 16 December 2025, in force 17 December 2025) https://www.rd.go.th/fileadmin/user_upload/kormor/newlaw/mofexpandfornet9A.pdf, for returns due within the No. 7 window (to 31 January 2027) https://www.rd.go.th/fileadmin/user_upload/kormor/newlaw/mofexpandfornet7A.pdf.

name: Withholding certificate to employees (50 Tawi)

rules.description: Give each employee who worked to the end of the year the withholding tax certificate (50 Tawi) for the previous calendar year.
rules.authority: Revenue Code s.50 bis; Revenue Department guidance on withholding certificates: for income under s.40(1) and (2) the certificate is issued by 15 February of the year after the tax year (within one month of leaving for an employee who leaves during the year). https://www.rd.go.th/fileadmin/images/image_law/images/guide100248.pdf

name: Workmen's Compensation Fund annual contribution

rules.description: Pay the year's WCF contribution the Social Security Office assessed (Kor Tor 26 Kor) on the estimated wages of the year, at most 240,000 baht a person. A task, not a remittance row: the amount is the SSO assessment, not the run totals (the WCF scheme line accrues the liability month by month).
rules.authority: the Ministry of Labour notification on business types, sizes and areas liable to contribute, contribution rates, deposits and the assessment and collection of contributions (21 February 2019, under WCA ss.44 para 1 and 45) cl.13: from the second year the estimated contribution for the whole year is paid within January (the first within 30 days of becoming liable, WCA s.44; payment by instalments on approval under cl.16-18); WCA s.46: 2% a month on late payment. https://www.sso.go.th/wpr/download/download_by_pool_file/14479

name: Workmen's Compensation Fund wage statement (Kor Tor 20 Kor)

rules.description: Report the wages actually paid in the previous year on form Kor Tor 20 Kor (e-wage); the SSO adjusts the contribution.
rules.authority: the Ministry of Labour notification on business types, sizes and areas liable to contribute, contribution rates, deposits and the assessment and collection of contributions (21 February 2019, under WCA ss.44 para 1 and 45) cl.14 para 1: within February each year the employer reports the wages actually paid in the previous year (Kor Tor 20 Kor). https://www.sso.go.th/wpr/download/download_by_pool_file/14479

name: Annual employment and working conditions report (Kor Ror 11)

rules.description: An employer of ten or more employees submits the annual report on employment and working conditions to the Department of Labour Protection and Welfare.
rules.authority: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) s.115/1 (as amended by Labour Protection Act (No. 9) B.E. 2568 (Royal Gazette 7 November 2025, in force 7 December 2025)): within January of each year.

name: Disabled-person employment quota or fund contribution

rules.description: An employer of 100 or more employees employs one person with disabilities for every 100 employees (s.33) or pays the Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities Fund for each shortfall (s.34) at 365 days of the highest minimum wage. Raised on the January run when the entity's contracts in force that day number 100 or more; the Act counts on 1 October.
rules.authority: Persons with Disabilities Empowerment Act B.E. 2550 ss.33-34 with the Ministerial Regulation on the employment of persons with disabilities B.E. 2554: the count is taken on 1 October and the fund contribution is paid by 31 January.

name: Register the employee with the Social Security Office (Sor Por Sor 1-03)

rules.description: Submit the insured-person registration (Sor Por Sor 1-03) for a new employee.
rules.authority: Social Security Act B.E. 2533 s.34: "within thirty days from the date on which the employees have become insured persons". https://www.sso.go.th/wpr/download/download_by_pool_file/47435

name: Employee register entry

rules.description: An employer of ten or more employees enters the employee in the employee register kept at the workplace.
rules.authority: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 s.112: an employer of ten or more keeps an employee register in Thai, made "within fifteen days as from the date the employees start working" (Office of the Council of State translation https://www.vertic.org/media/National%20Legislation/Thailand/TH_Labor_Protection_Act.pdf).

name: Notify the Social Security Office of the employee leaving (Sor Por Sor 6-09)

rules.description: Notify the termination of the insured person on form Sor Por Sor 6-09.
rules.authority: Social Security Act B.E. 2533 s.44 para 1 (as amended by the SSA (No. 4) B.E. 2558): a change in the particulars filed, including the employee leaving, is notified "within the fifteenth day of the month following the month in which the change has taken place". https://www.sso.go.th/wpr/download/download_by_pool_file/47435
rules.when: contract != null && contract.exit_facts != null && contract.effective_range.to != null

name: Pay wages and money due on termination

rules.description: Pay the wages, overtime pay, holiday pay and holiday overtime pay due when the employer ends the employment.
rules.authority: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 s.70 para 2: where the employer terminates the employment, "wage, overtime pay, holiday pay and holiday overtime pay" are paid "within three days as from the employment termination date" (Office of the Council of State translation https://www.vertic.org/media/National%20Legislation/Thailand/TH_Labor_Protection_Act.pdf). Severance (s.118) and the annual-leave pay of s.67 are owed on termination without this deadline.
rules.when: contract != null && contract.exit_facts != null && contract.effective_range.to != null

name: Withholding certificate to a leaving employee (50 Tawi)

rules.description: Give a leaving employee the withholding tax certificate for the income paid in the year.
rules.authority: Revenue Code s.50 bis; Revenue Department guidance on withholding certificates: within one month of the day the employee leaves during the tax year. https://www.rd.go.th/fileadmin/images/image_law/images/guide100248.pdf
rules.when: contract != null && contract.exit_facts != null && contract.effective_range.to != null

name: Notify the registrar of a foreign employee taken on

rules.description: Notify the Department of Employment registrar of the name, nationality and work of a foreign employee taken on.
rules.authority: Royal Ordinance on the Management of the Employment of Foreign Workers B.E. 2560 s.13 (as amended by the Royal Ordinance (No. 2) B.E. 2561): the employer notifies the registrar of the name, nationality and work of a foreign worker within 15 days of employing them, and within 15 days of the day the worker leaves, with the reason; an employer whose foreign staff are permitted under the investment-promotion or petroleum law (s.62) is exempt (employee fact work_permit_basis SECTION_62). Department of Employment, Chiang Mai Provincial Employment Office briefing: https://chiangmai.boi.go.th/uploads/file_download/file/20180828/th-bdfgjloz2459.pdf
rules.applies_when: employee.nationality != "" && employee.nationality != "TH" && !(has(employee.facts) && employee.facts != null && has(employee.facts.work_permit_basis) && employee.facts.work_permit_basis == "SECTION_62")

name: Notify the registrar of a foreign employee leaving

rules.description: Notify the Department of Employment registrar that the employment of a foreign employee has ended, with the reason.
rules.authority: Royal Ordinance on the Management of the Employment of Foreign Workers B.E. 2560 s.13 (as amended by the Royal Ordinance (No. 2) B.E. 2561): the employer notifies the registrar of the name, nationality and work of a foreign worker within 15 days of employing them, and within 15 days of the day the worker leaves, with the reason; an employer whose foreign staff are permitted under the investment-promotion or petroleum law (s.62) is exempt (employee fact work_permit_basis SECTION_62). Department of Employment, Chiang Mai Provincial Employment Office briefing: https://chiangmai.boi.go.th/uploads/file_download/file/20180828/th-bdfgjloz2459.pdf
rules.when: contract != null && contract.exit_facts != null && contract.effective_range.to != null
rules.applies_when: employee.nationality != "" && employee.nationality != "TH" && !(has(employee.facts) && employee.facts != null && has(employee.facts.work_permit_basis) && employee.facts.work_permit_basis == "SECTION_62")

name: Workmen's Compensation Fund additional contribution (Kor Tor 25 Kor)

rules.description: Where the wages reported on Kor Tor 20 Kor exceed the January estimate, pay the additional contribution the Social Security Office bills on form Kor Tor 25 Kor.
rules.authority: the Ministry of Labour notification on business types, sizes and areas liable to contribute, contribution rates, deposits and the assessment and collection of contributions (21 February 2019, under WCA ss.44 para 1 and 45) cl.15 para 2: an additional contribution from the cl.14 statement is paid within March; WCA s.46: 2% a month on late payment. https://www.sso.go.th/wpr/download/download_by_pool_file/14479

name: Register as an employer with the Social Security Office (Sor Por Sor 1-01) and the WCF

rules.description: Register the business as an employer under the Social Security Act and the Workmen's Compensation Act once it first employs an employee.
rules.authority: Social Security Act B.E. 2533 s.34 and Workmen's Compensation Act B.E. 2537 as amended by the Workmen's Compensation Act (No. 2) B.E. 2561 s.44: the employer files the registration within 30 days of the day it first has an employee (SSO WCF employer guide: "ขึ้นทะเบียนนายจ้าง พร้อมกับขึ้นทะเบียนลูกจ้าง ภายใน 30 วัน"). https://www.sso.go.th/wpr/assets/upload/files_storage/sso_th/21f9d80408a598636551a7c559cd7920.pdf

name: Provident fund contributions paid into the fund

rules.description: Pay the members' contributions deducted and the employer's contributions into the registered provident fund.
rules.authority: Revenue Code s.65 ter(2) with Ministerial Regulation No. 183 (B.E. 2533) items 3-4: the employer's contributions are paid into the fund within three working days of the wage payment (Revenue Department ruling 0706/4613 of 8 May 2007, https://www.rd.go.th/35308.html). Wages are taken as paid on the last day of the period.

name: Announce work rules in Thai (10 employees)

rules.description: An employer that comes to employ ten employees announces work rules in Thai, posts them at the workplace and gives a copy to the labour office.
rules.authority: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) s.108: an employer of ten or more employees has work rules in Thai, announced within 15 days of the day it comes to have ten employees — "within fifteen days as from the date the aggregate amount of the employees … reach to ten" (Office of the Council of State translation https://www.vertic.org/media/National%20Legislation/Thailand/TH_Labor_Protection_Act.pdf). Raised on the hire that brings the contracts in force to ten.

name: Notify the SSO of a work injury (Kor Tor 16)

rules.description: Notify the Social Security Office of an employee's work injury, sickness or disappearance.
rules.authority: Workmen's Compensation Act B.E. 2537 as amended by the Workmen's Compensation Act (No. 2) B.E. 2561 s.48: "ให้นายจ้างแจ้งเหตุดังกล่าวต่อสำนักงาน … ภายในสิบห้าวันนับแต่วันที่นายจ้างทราบ" — within 15 days of the day the employer knows. https://www.sso.go.th/wpr/assets/upload/files_storage/sso_th/84244ea51a2464c0713a98ddd8cc0955.pdf Raised by a SICK_LEAVE entry whose facts mark a work injury (facts.work_injury); its first day stands for the day the employer knew.
rules.when: row.catalog_code == "SICK_LEAVE" && has(row.facts) && row.facts != null && has(row.facts.work_injury) && row.facts.work_injury == true

name: Provincial minimum wage

rules.when: !(has(company.facts.minimum_wage_exempt) && company.facts.minimum_wage_exempt) && company.region in rules.minimum_wage.by_region && ((has(term.facts) && term.facts != null && has(term.facts.pay_basis) && term.facts.pay_basis == "DAILY") ? term.base_salary : term.monthly_wage / 30.0) < double((has(company.facts.minimum_wage_400_business) && company.facts.minimum_wage_400_business ? rules.minimum_wage.business_400 : rules.minimum_wage.by_region[company.region]))
rules.message: The contract pays less than the minimum wage of the workplace's province (Wage Committee Notification No. 14 cl.20): a day's wage — the day rate, or the monthly wage with its fixed allowances divided by 30 (LPA s.68) — must be at least the area rate.
rules.description: Wage Committee Notification on Minimum Wage Rates (No. 14), Royal Gazette vol.142 special part 236 Ngor, 1 July 2025, cl.2-18 (rates by area; 400 for category 2-4 hotels and service establishments), cl.19 ("วัน" is the normal working time, however short), cl.20 ("ห้ามมิให้นายจ้างจ่ายค่าจ้าง … น้อยกว่าอัตราค่าจ้างขั้นต่ำ") https://ratchakitcha.soc.go.th/documents/76681.pdf; Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) ss.68, 90. An entity whose region is not a key of the table is not checked. An employer outside the notification (explanatory note item 7: central, regional and local government, state enterprises, non-profit employers, sea-cargo loading, home work, seasonal agriculture) records the entity fact minimum_wage_exempt.

name: Overtime and holiday work above 36 hours a week

rules.when: work.days.exists(d, sum(work.days.filter(e, int(calendar_distance_days("2024-01-01", e.date)) / 7 == int(calendar_distance_days("2024-01-01", d.date)) / 7).map(e, e.overtime_hours + ((e.holiday_kind != "" || e.day_type == "REST") ? min(max(e.worked_hours - e.overtime_hours, 0.0), (terms.work_classification == "HAZARDOUS" ? 7.0 : 8.0)) : 0.0))) > 36.0)
rules.message: Overtime plus holiday work exceeds 36 hours in a week (LPA s.26 with Ministerial Regulation No. 3): the hours are paid, but the employer may not require them.
rules.description: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) s.26: overtime and holiday work together may not exceed the weekly hours the Ministerial Regulation prescribes — 36 hours a week (Ministerial Regulation No. 3 (B.E. 2541)) (s.26 read in the Office of the Council of State translation; the 36-hour figure of Ministerial Regulation No. 3 was not obtained — its Council of State index entry has no PDF). A week is Monday to Sunday; hours are the approved overtime of every day plus the normal hours worked on a holiday or weekly rest day.

name: Loan deduction above 10% of wages

rules.when: !(has(employee.facts.deduction_consent) && employee.facts.deduction_consent) && ((has(payslip.lines.WELFARE_LOAN) ? -payslip.lines.WELFARE_LOAN : 0.0) > payslip.gross * 0.1 || (has(statutory.PVD) ? statutory.PVD.employee : 0.0) > payslip.gross * 0.1 || (has(payslip.lines.WELFARE_LOAN) ? -payslip.lines.WELFARE_LOAN : 0.0) + (has(statutory.PVD) ? statutory.PVD.employee : 0.0) > payslip.gross * 0.2)
rules.message: A deduction exceeds the LPA s.76 limits — 10% of the wages due for the loan or the provident fund contribution, one fifth for both together — without the employee's recorded prior consent: the slip is held.
rules.description: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 s.76: deductions for union dues, cooperative or welfare debts, a guarantee or damages, and provident fund contributions "for each case shall not be made exceeding ten per cent, and the aggregate amount thereof shall not exceed one-fifth … except where prior consent is given by the employee" (Office of the Council of State translation https://www.vertic.org/media/National%20Legislation/Thailand/TH_Labor_Protection_Act.pdf). Customer input: employee fact deduction_consent records that consent.

name: Send a copy of the work rules to the labour office

rules.description: Submit a copy of the announced work rules to the Director-General of the Department of Labour Protection and Welfare.
rules.authority: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 s.108 para 2: "submit the copy thereof to the Director-General … within seven days as from the date the working regulations has been notified" (Office of the Council of State translation https://www.vertic.org/media/National%20Legislation/Thailand/TH_Labor_Protection_Act.pdf); due here 7 days after the latest announcement day (15 days from the tenth employee).

name: WCF wage statement on closing the business

rules.description: On closing the business, report the wages paid up to the closing day so the SSO can settle the year's WCF contribution.
rules.authority: the Ministry of Labour notification on business types, sizes and areas liable to contribute, contribution rates, deposits and the assessment and collection of contributions (21 February 2019, under WCA ss.44 para 1 and 45) cl.14 para 2: an employer that ceases business reports the wages "ภายในสามสิบวันนับแต่วันที่เลิกกิจการ". https://www.sso.go.th/wpr/download/download_by_pool_file/14479 Customer input: entity fact business_closed_on.

name: Workmen's Compensation Fund base rates by business code (% of wages)

rules.authority: the Ministry of Labour notification on business types, sizes and areas liable to contribute, contribution rates, deposits and the assessment and collection of contributions (21 February 2019, under WCA ss.44 para 1 and 45) Table 1 (อัตราเงินสมทบ, ร้อยละของค่าจ้าง): 1,091 business codes, 0.20%-1.00%; the code is the one the SSO assigned the employer (cl.7-8), held as entity risk_class. https://www.sso.go.th/wpr/download/download_by_pool_file/14479 A Ministry of Labour revision reported for 1 January 2027 (452 codes lowered) is not yet in this table.
